# VEGA Mexican Cuisine

> VEGA Mexican Cuisine, located in Hartsdale, NY, offers a diverse menu of traditional Mexican dishes ranging from appetizers and street corn to various fajitas, quesadillas, and seafood specialties under the tagline "EAT. DRINK. FIESTA."

## Services
### Catering Appetizers
- California Nachos (Beans & Cheese)
- California Nachos (Chicken)
- California Nachos (Chorizo)
- California Nachos (Steak)
- Taquitos (Chicken)
- Taquitos (Steak)
- Wings of Fire
- Cancun Calamari
- Shrimp Ceviche
- Tableside Guacamole
- Avocado Fritters
- Avocado Salad
- Mexican Street Corn
- Shrimp al Ajillo
- Charred Cauliflower

### Catering Desserts
- Apple Taco
- Chocolate Mousse
- Vanilla Flan
- Churros

- Lemon Chipotle Chicken

### Catering Classics
